name: Shackle Key
summary: The Shackle Key is held by Hitah'ya the Keeper in a cave near Jintha'alor. Elder Torntusk needs it to loosen his bindings and return home.

sections.title: The Bound Elder
sections.body: At Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands, Elder Torntusk waits for the key to his bindings. Hitah'ya the Keeper holds it in a nearby cave and is well guarded. Bring the key back to Torntusk so he can be freed and return home.

faq.answer: Hitah'ya the Keeper holds the Shackle Key in a cave near Jintha'alor.

faq.q: What is the Shackle Key for?
faq.answer: The Shackle Key loosens Elder Torntusk's bindings so he can return home.
Hitah'ya the Keeper holds the key in a cave near Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.
Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor needs the key to free himself from his bindings.
